summary: Iteration 35 backend-only verification of the new WhatsApp Provider 'Out for Delivery' event. Created /app/backend/tests/test_whatsapp_out_for_delivery.py covering all four requested checks: (T1) catalogue exposure and ordering via GET /api/admin/whatsapp-provider/events, (T2) STAGE_TO_EVENT_KEY direct-import mapping incl. non-regression of prior status keys, (T3) seeded Mongo row in whatsapp_event_triggers with correct default fields, (T4) regression check that all 8 pre-existing events remain. All 7 tests passed (7/7, 100%).
critical_code_review_comments: Catalogue ordering is enforced by list_events() iterating EVENT_CATALOG, so the shipped→out_for_delivery→delivered ordering is guaranteed by source-code order — safe.
Seed is idempotent (find_one before insert), so subsequent restarts won't duplicate the new event.
STAGE_TO_EVENT_KEY dict preserves insertion order in Python 3.7+, but the mapping's correctness does not depend on order — value equality is what matters.
